FR-001.title: One generic FBL implementation that names no tool type or example binding

FR-002.title: Part of the installable plug-in, in every IDE on the platform, with no network

FR-004.title: Connected to no tool, editor, action or setting; FreeMind and draw.io unchanged

FR-005.title: Host, declared of FBL 0.1 for yaml, json, xml, lines and blocks

FR-006.title: Loads an FBL document by section 14.1 and reports every problem with its location

FR-007.title: Reads a body tolerantly into elements, relations, values, positions and findings

FR-008.title: Plans every edit as splices in the body's conventions; an unedited save is the bytes read

FR-009.title: A history with exact undo and redo, refused on drift

FR-010.title: Reads and writes the .adp registration with layout, identities and legacy sidecars

FR-011.title: Routes a file or folder to its bindings and produces a body from a template

FR-012.title: The host's part of the plugin contract

FR-013.title: The limits of section 16: match time, body size, entry count, paths, templates

FR-014.title: The bytes every other conforming host produces; open questions go to specifications/fbl

FR-015.title: An unchanged copy of the bindings, fixtures and registrations with commit and licence, kept from conversion

FR-016.title: Every fixture run as section 15.3 defines; discovery fails on none

FR-017.title: Every baseline test has a named counterpart with the same inputs and results

FR-018.title: A baseline test that cannot apply is listed with its reason

FR-019.title: The real-file properties over every .mm of the repository and a copied corpus for each other binding

FR-020.title: The mindmap binding's node ids compared with the FreeMind module's parser

FR-021.title: Every real .adp parsed and saved unchanged; every enumeration asserts a minimum

FR-022.title: Disagreements recorded with reason; unrecorded and stale ones fail

FR-023.title: One test in a headless IDE walks a fixture through read, save, edit and undo

FR-024.title: Every test written before its behaviour and seen to fail

FR-025.title: The Build workflow runs every test; no compiler warnings

FR-026.title: The documentation says what the plug-in carries, what it claims and where the corpus comes from

FR-027.title: Every divergence and open question reported to etalii.adp

expectations: Wiring FBL into the existing FreeMind and draw.io diagrams
Changes to FBL itself; those go through their own feature in specifications/fbl
A shared package of fixtures across hosts
No tool, editor, action or setting is connected to the implementation
The FreeMind and draw.io modules are not changed or moved onto a binding
No JSON Schema validation of FBL documents
No DISL: tool types, derived ids and constraints stay out
No file watching or shared open bodies between readings

decisions.decision: A new Gradle module fbl (package etalii.adp.fbl), composed into the plug-in and registered nowhere
decisions.why: Composing ships it (FR-002), registering nothing keeps FR-004, and a module of its own gives one test command (SC-008)
decisions.rejected: A package inside core, which imports the platform and knows no file format

decisions.decision: The module works on byte offsets with its own BodyText and scanners; core's TextChange and XmlScanner are not reused
decisions.why: FBL fixtures state byte offsets, core counts UTF-16 characters and imports the platform, and 16 of the 108 maps hold non-ASCII text
decisions.rejected: A byte-to-character map over core.xml, which cannot hold an invalid UTF-8 body

decisions.decision: Hand-written span-preserving JSON, YAML, XML and lines parsers and a CEL evaluator, ported from standalone, with no third-party library
decisions.why: Splices need byte spans, duplicate keys need locations, and the module must run without the platform's jars
decisions.rejected: Platform-bundled Gson, Jackson or SnakeYAML, and cel-java

decisions.decision: The module's own YAML parser decides whether a yaml body is well-formed
decisions.why: No YAML library may be shipped, and unreadable is the safe side because nothing is written
decisions.rejected: SnakeYAML Engine from the platform; the possible disagreement with standalone's YamlDotNet is reported to etalii.adp

decisions.decision: Regular expressions run on java.util.regex behind the ported subset validator, bounded by a CharSequence whose charAt throws after a 250 ms deadline
decisions.why: Java's regex has no timeout, and the wrapper needs no thread and no library
decisions.rejected: A worker thread per match, and RE2/J as a shipped dependency

decisions.decision: Numbers in new text follow ECMAScript Number.prototype.toString, built from Double.toString; fixed decimals use BigDecimal HALF_UP
decisions.why: It is what standalone writes, and Double.toString alone gives 640.0 and 1.0E21
decisions.rejected: String.format, which is locale-sensitive and not shortest round-trip

decisions.decision: Ids DISL would derive come from an optional deriveId function in FblOptions; the tests supply NaturalIds under src/test
decisions.why: Most fixture ids follow DISL, and main code must name no binding (FR-001)

decisions.decision: Refusal and drift sentences are standalone's, word for word, and a refused fixture step is compared by its reason string
decisions.why: The baseline tests assert these strings and FR-017 asks for the same expected results
decisions.rejected: Sentences in this host's own wording; that FBL specifies none is reported to etalii.adp

decisions.decision: The conformance corpus is written with git archive into fbl/testdata/conformance, under a -text rule added first, with a SHA256SUMS list a test checks
decisions.why: The .fbl files are text=auto in etalii.adp, so a working-tree copy differs from the blob, and the digest list notices a converted or edited file
decisions.rejected: A licence sibling per file, and a git submodule

decisions.decision: The real-file corpus is the repository's 108 .mm maps plus the 41 files standalone's five other declared bindings take, with the registrations naming them and standalone's paths kept
decisions.why: The same inputs as the baseline's real-file tests, and divergence records that compare entry by entry between hosts
decisions.rejected: One file per binding, the minimum FR-019 allows

decisions.decision: The cross-check compares MapNode.id() walked in document order with the ids the node rule reads
decisions.why: MindMap.nodesByKey is unordered and its keys fall back to an index path

decisions.decision: The headless IDE test is an in-process BasePlatformTestCase in fbl, with a second test that inspects the built zip
decisions.why: SC-006 asks for the network off, a Starter test downloads its IDE, and nothing is registered for a driver to call
decisions.rejected: A Starter and Driver test through @Remote with a new static entry point

decisions.decision: An inventory table of 86 rows maps each baseline test to its counterpart, checked by BaselineCoverageTest
decisions.why: It is the repository's own InventoryCoverageTest pattern and makes FR-017's correspondence readable and enforced
FR-025 requires no compiler warnings and nothing in the repository enforces it
decisions.rejected: Relying on convention, or turning it on for every module in this feature

decisions.decision: Number writing follows standalone's code, not ECMAScript's Number.prototype.toString
decisions.why: The fixtures were produced by standalone; it writes 1e-7 as 0.0000001 and rounds fixed decimals in double arithmetic
decisions.rejected: BigDecimal HALF_UP from Double.toString, as research R8 had it

decisions.decision: The conformance corpus is copied with line-ending conversion switched off
decisions.why: git archive converts .fbl files as a checkout would; each copied file now equals its blob
decisions.rejected: Plain git archive, as research R12 had it

decisions.decision: The real files are copied in the form standalone checks them out, mostly CRLF
decisions.why: Its .gitattributes forces CRLF, so that is what its own real-file tests read

decisions.decision: The yaml parser itself refuses some malformed YAML with sentences of its own
decisions.why: No YAML library may be shipped, and standalone leaves well-formedness to one
decisions.rejected: Accepting everything standalone's parser alone accepts

decisions.decision: Tasks in etalii.adp.ide.intellij are journaled and not ticked
decisions.why: CLAUDE.md: a task in another repository is ticked only once its pull request is merged

concerns.note: {"concern": "A hand-written YAML parser can disagree with standalone's YamlDotNet on whether a body is well-formed", "why": "FBL does not say which YAML a host must accept; reported under FR-027"}

{"concern": "The headless IDE test does not start a real IDE from the installed zip", "why": "The in-process test and the zip inspection together are read as meeting FR-023; the review of this plan may ask for a Starter test instead"}

plan.summary: Plan for a host-free fbl module in etalii.adp.ide.intellij, ported from standalone at 25fc7b4a, proven by the eight fixtures, 86 counterparts, 149 real files and one platform test
plan.key_finding: Every existing offset in the IntelliJ repository counts UTF-16 characters and its core package imports the platform, so nothing there can be reused for FBL's byte splices

tasks.summary: 67 tasks in 7 phases: Setup 9, Foundational 11, US1 21, US2 10, US3 7, US4 3, Polish 6; each phase laid out as waves, tests first

implement.summary: T001 to T064 done: the fbl module with 1175 tests green in the IntelliJ worktree, 29 commits, not pushed

approach: Port standalone's FBL library at 25fc7b4a into a new Gradle module fbl in etalii.adp.ide.intellij: Java 25, byte offsets throughout, hand-written parsers, no dependency and no import from the platform, composed into the plug-in and registered nowhere. Tests are written first, layer by layer: the eight published fixtures, a counterpart for each of the 86 baseline tests tracked in an inventory table, the real-file properties over 108 .mm maps and 41 files copied from standalone, a node-id comparison with the FreeMind parser, and one test on the headless platform. Open questions and divergences go to etalii.adp as one issue.
